definition: Recalling after [crashing](/term/crash) the first three [minion waves](/term/wave) of the game such that minimal minions are lost upon returning to lane. A cheater recall is a reliable strategy for creating a lead after obtaining level one priority. The recall grants the [player](/term/player) full resources, as well as the ability to spend their gold on items for a [combat](/term/combat) advantage. The common follow-up on a cheater recall is to return to lane, without using teleport, before the opposing wave [crashes](/term/crash). This allows the player to leverage their combat advantage, often to create a [freeze](/term/freeze). While technically performable in bot lane, the cheater recall is most frequently used in top lane.
